route_summary: Boto3 Converse sample that sends a local image and prompt as typed multimodal content, then returns the actual model response and usage metadata.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+ boto3 1.43.114, compatible vision-capable model and Region, model access, buyer credentials, supported image format and service limits. Sends image bytes to remote Bedrock and incurs inference charges; never executed by hosted preview.
